Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing applied doctorate level degrees in audiology at Western Washington University.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to applied doctorate level degrees in audiology atWestern Washington University; and adding a new section to chapter28B.35 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.35 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The board of trustees of Western Washington University may offerapplied, but not research, doctorate level degrees in audiology subjectto review.
